trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Iran's military command threatens intensified attacks on US/Israeli infrastructure and oil/gas facilities in the region; Trump maintains hard line with 8 PM deadline while Pakistan negotiates 2-week ceasefire extension. S&P 500 swung from red to green on ceasefire hopes, oil prices hit record highs, and EIA raised forecasts amid Middle East conflict escalation.

trends.name: OpenAI Leadership Crisis & Elon Musk Lawsuit
trends.summary: Elon Musk seeks ouster of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman as part of ongoing lawsuit; Walter Isaacson discusses leadership implications. This represents major friction in AI governance and corporate control that affects broader AI sector credibility and investor confidence.

trends.name: AI Job Displacement & Labor Market Impact
trends.summary: AI has already displaced 3 million jobs according to reports, signaling structural shifts in labor markets. This raises questions about consumer spending power, wage inflation, and long-term economic productivity that impact corporate earnings and Fed policy considerations.

trends.name: Cybersecurity Sector AI Validation Rally
trends.summary: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks shares surge as cybersecurity companies finally demonstrate concrete AI integration benefits. Meanwhile, Anthropic limits Mythos AI rollout over cyberattack concerns, showing both opportunities and risks in security-focused AI applications.

trends.name: Apple's Foldable iPhone Strategy Delayed
trends.summary: Apple shares fluctuated on reports of foldable iPhone delays, but CEO commentary suggests 'cheap AI bet is paying off big' in near term. Market weighing product innovation timeline against near-term AI-driven services momentum and margin expansion.

trends.name: Tech Sector Breadth Recovery & Broadcom Strength
trends.summary: Flurry of positive tech signals from Broadcom and other semiconductor names suggest potential return of growth trends to tech sector. S&P 500 recovery trajectory tied to renewed confidence in tech earnings and AI capex cycle continuation.

trends.name: Apparel & Retail Resilience: Levi's Beats
trends.summary: Levi Strauss boosts sales outlook and DTC exceeds 50% of sales for first time; Redbook same-store sales accelerate to highest year-over-year growth since late 2022. Consumer spending remains robust despite Iran conflict concerns and tariff headwinds.

trends.name: Tariff Refund Liability & Corporate Windfalls
trends.summary: Supreme Court ruled Trump's tariffs unconstitutional; $175 billion refund liability emerges but corporations—not consumers—will receive compensation. Creates contingent liability questions for corporate tax planning and equity valuations in 2026.

trends.name: Healthcare REIT Recovery & Medical Properties Trust
trends.summary: Medical Properties Trust signals new tenant risk but shows promising recovery cadence; Healthcare Realty identified as mispriced high-yield bargain. Sector showing contrarian value opportunities as operational pressures ease and occupancy trends improve.

trends.name: Offshore Prediction Markets & Regulatory Crackdown
trends.summary: House Democrats call on federal regulators to crack down on offshore prediction market war bets, signaling growing regulatory scrutiny of speculative instruments tied to geopolitical events. Potential impact on fintech and betting platforms.

trends.name: Bank Earnings Pivot & 2026 Guidance Reset
trends.summary: Bank of America earnings viewed as pivotal for 2026 expectations amid volatile rates, geopolitical risk, and potential tariff impacts. Financial sector earnings will reset market expectations for net interest margins and loan growth.

trends.name: Universal Music Takeover & M&A Activity
trends.summary: Universal Music stock rises on Pershing Square's $64 billion takeover proposal, signaling activist pressure in media/entertainment sector. Reflects broader M&A momentum and private equity interest in cash-generative assets amid uncertain macro environment.
